_note: Structured facts taken from the approved procedures of the fictional Station 41. Used for conflict detection.

value_facts.statement: Notify the Shift Supervisor within 15 minutes of the alert.
Personnel go to Assembly Point B.
Only the Station Reliability Engineer can close a W-217 or W-305 anomaly.
Alert G-118 is always Band Red.

escalation_facts.statement: W-217 is abnormal and always requires escalation.
W-305 is abnormal and requires escalation.
W-412 requires escalation before the end of the current shift.
A blank or frozen display is abnormal and is reported to the Shift Supervisor.
If the Shift Supervisor cannot be reached, contact the Operations Control Desk directly.
